question: Which canonical implementation issue should RFC 0003 link, and is the shipped Policy implementation complete enough for `status: completed`?
rationale: The repository lifecycle requires both fields, but the canonical implementation tracker and any remaining implementation scope are not present in the PR context.

options.title: Mark completed and link implementation
options.body: Set `status: completed` and populate `issue` with the canonical tracker for the shipped Policy implementation.

options.title: Keep accepted with remaining scope
options.body: Keep `status: accepted`, populate `issue`, and document the concrete implementation work that is still outstanding.

recommendation.title: Mark completed and link implementation
recommendation.body: Set `status: completed` and populate `issue` with the canonical tracker for the shipped Policy implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the existing Policy RFC and is best positioned to identify its implementation lineage, with maintainer confirmation before merge.
